description: A single addressable RGB LED driven over one data wire (WS2812 protocol), with its own regulated 5V/GND supply pins.
how_to_use: VDD/VSS are power, DIN is the data input from the microcontroller (or from the previous NeoPixel's DOUT), and DOUT passes the same data stream on to the next NeoPixel in a chain — DIN/DOUT is a plain digital signal (bit-banged by the sketch), not a shared bus, so each link in a chain is its own independent connection.

plain.what: A colour LED with its own tiny chip, so you can set any colour with just one data wire.
plain.how: Connect 5V, GND and one Arduino pin to DIN. A library (like Adafruit NeoPixel) sets the colour.
